title: Assistant Manager - Product Delivery
description:
Assistant Manager – Product Delivery
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 At IDfy, a great product only creates value when it actually lands \- deployed, adopted, and working in the real world. As our Assistant Manager – Product Delivery, you'll be the person who makes that happen: turning client requirements into working solutions, translating messy real\-world problems into clean product outcomes, and owning delivery end\-to\-end from the first conversation to go\-live. If you love figuring out "what the client actually needs, how to solve it, and how to ship it" \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**We're The Perfect Match If You**
* Have 1–3 years of experience in a client\-facing implementation, SaaS delivery, solutioning, or technical project role.
* Have worked directly with enterprise clients and juggled multiple stakeholders and workstreams without dropping the ball.
* Are AI\-first and hands\-on \- you reach for AI tools instinctively to move faster and solve smarter.
* Bring a can\-do attitude \- when someone says "this is tricky," your first instinct is "let's figure it out."
* Communicate with clarity and influence \- equally comfortable aligning a client's HR team and rallying internal Product \& Engineering.
* Thrive on ownership and ambiguity \- you'd rather run a thread yourself than wait for a map.


**Here's What Your Day Would Look Like**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of IDfy's products for clients \- from requirement understanding through solutioning, UAT, and go\-live \- within agreed timelines.
* Get deep into the client's employee onboarding journey and HRTech ecosystem to spot process and product gaps before they become delivery issues.
* Translate client requirements into clear, actionable asks for internal teams \- and translate the most appropriate solution back out to the client.
* Partner across teams to balance what the client wants against what's buildable, scalable, and on\-time.
* Act as the key point of contact across the delivery lifecycle, keeping clients and internal Product / Engineering / Sales / CX aligned.
* Run multiple client implementations at once \- tracking dependencies, risks, blockers, and timelines, and prioritizing by client impact and business criticality.
* Spot recurring patterns and push to standardize and improve how delivery gets done.


 Why IDfy
   

  

 At IDfy, we don't just build products \- we build trust infrastructure for the digital economy. In this role, you'll sit at the frontline of how that trust actually reaches clients: owning delivery, shaping solutions, and working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with Product and Engineering.
   

  

 If you've ever wanted to turn delivery puzzles into product wins \- this is your playground.

title: Manager - Ecommerce transformation

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

+ Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify conversion improvement, revenue uplift, digital adoption, cost\-to\-serve reduction, and operational productivity gains.
+ Ensure delivery excellence across assigned workstreams, including scope, timeline, budget, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment.

* Have exposure to leading commerce platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Shopify, SAP Commerce Cloud, commerce tools, BigCommerce, Akeneo, Salsify, and similar technologies.

* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading ecommerce transformation programs, digital channel improvement initiatives, or commerce operating model redesign.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce journeys, digital merchandising, product information management, order experience, conversion optimization, and commerce performance metrics.
* Hands\-on experience with ecommerce platforms, analytics tools, PIM, OMS, CRM, or related digital commerce technologies.
* Strong business development support, stakeholder management, communication, and project delivery skills.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose\-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
   

  

**Overview** 
  

  

 The Senior AI Test Analyst is responsible for defining, implementing, and executing testing strategies for AI\-powered solutions, including AI agents, generative AI applications, machine learning models, APIs, and business process workflows. The role focuses on AI model validation, data quality assessment, performance testing, responsible AI compliance, and the automation of testing processes to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, secure, and high\-quality AI solutions.
   

 As MUFG Retirement Solutions continues to embed AI across its technology landscape, this role plays a key part in driving the adoption of AI\-enabled testing practices and automation capabilities. The position is responsible for identifying innovative and cost\-effective solutions, leveraging AI to enhance testing efficiency, quality, and coverage while promoting industry best practices.
   

 The role also ensures that the AI testing and automation strategy aligns with business objectives, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and the broader technology vision of MUFG Retirement Solutions.
   

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities** 
  

 Strategic Focus 
   

* Develop and execute testing strategies for AI, Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI solutions to ensure accuracy, reliability, performance, and business value.
* Define and implement robust AI test frameworks, methodologies, and automation solutions covering functional, integration, API, system, end\-to\-end, model validation, data validation, prompt validation, and adversarial testing scenarios.
* Establish comprehensive validation processes for AI model outputs against business requirements, acceptance criteria, Responsible AI principles, regulatory standards, and organizational governance policies.
* Drive quality assurance across the complete AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, data preparation, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, inference, monitoring, retraining, and reporting.
* Assess AI solution performance across dimensions such as accuracy, relevance, consistency, explainability, fairness, robustness, and reliability.
* Integrate AI testing activities and test automation framework \& scripts with continuous integration, CI/CD pipelines and tools to support continuous testing and deployment of AI solutions.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, product owners, and project managers to define testing requirements, success criteria, and quality measures.
* Manage the execution of automated test suites, monitor the test results and collaborate with teams to troubleshoot and resolve the issues promptly.
* Lead defect triage, root cause analysis, and quality risk management activities, ensuring timely resolution of issues impacting AI model performance and business outcomes.
* Champion the adoption of AI\-enabled testing tools, intelligent automation techniques, synthetic test data generation, and predictive quality engineering practices to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* Drive research and evaluation of emerging AI testing methodologies, LLM evaluation frameworks, model benchmarking techniques, automation technologies, and industry best practices, providing strategic recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Establish and govern enterprise standards, processes, controls, and best practices for AI testing, validation, Responsible AI compliance, and model quality assurance across multiple AI initiatives.


  

 Operational Management
   

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain test cases and test scripts for AI, ML, and Generative AI applications.
* Validate data quality, data integrity, and data lineage across AI systems and supporting platforms.
* Lead functional, integration, API, regression, user acceptance, and end\-to\-end testing of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Assess AI model outputs for accuracy, consistency, bias, hallucinations, explainability, fairness, and alignment with business requirements and responsible AI standards.
* Execute prompt testing, response validation, and scenario\-based testing for Generative AI solutions.
* Execute model validation and inference testing activities, ensuring AI solutions perform consistently across diverse datasets, use cases, and operating conditions.
* Monitor and analyse test execution results, quality metrics, and model performance indicators, producing actionable insights and comprehensive test reports for stakeholders.
* Identify, document, track, and drive resolution of defects, model performance issues, data quality concerns, and AI\-specific risks throughout the testing lifecycle.
* Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver high\-quality AI solutions.
* Support test data preparation, environment validation, and model release verification activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance AI testing frameworks, processes, and automation capabilities.
* Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to project teams on AI testing methodologies, Responsible AI validation, test automation approaches, and emerging industry practices.
* Mentor junior testers and contribute to building AI testing capabilities across teams through coaching, standards adoption, and continuous learning initiatives.


  

 Governance \& Risk
   

* Identify quality, model, data, security, privacy, ethical, and compliance risks associated with AI solutions and proactively support mitigation activities.
* Validate adherence to Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, organizational policies, and governance standards.
* Conduct and support the assessment and reporting of AI\-related risks, including model bias, explainability, fairness, and data quality concerns.
* Maintain appropriate test evidence, validation reports, defect records, and audit documentation to support governance and compliance requirements.
* Escalate risks, issues, and control gaps that may impact AI solution quality, regulatory compliance, or business outcomes.


  

 The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time\-to\-time based on business needs.
   

**Experience \& Personal Attributes** 
  

 Experience
   

* 5\+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, and AI\-driven testing, with preference for candidates having 4\+ years of experience in Retirement Solutions, Financial Services, or BFSI domains.
* Strong experience in designing, developing, and executing AI\-powered test automation frameworks and quality assurance solutions using tools such as Selenium, Appium, UFT/OpenText (at least one mandatory), Python, Maven, Postman, REST APIs, SoapUI, Cortex, and Snowflake.
* Hands\-on experience leveraging AI\-assisted testing tools and technologies for test case generation, test optimization, defect prediction, intelligent test execution, and quality analytics.
* Strong understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and best practices, including test strategy, test planning, test design, test execution, defect management, reporting, and test governance.
* Experience validating AI/ML\-enabled applications, including model testing, data quality validation, prompt testing and optimization, response evaluation, bias and fairness assessment, hallucination detection, adversarial testing, explainability validation, and performance assessment of AI\-powered systems.
* Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Quality Assurance (SQA) processes across Agile, Waterfall, and DevOps delivery models.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices using tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Azure Repos, Bitbucket, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to define quality standards, establish AI testing governance, track AI model evaluation metrics and quality KPIs, automate validation processes, and ensure reliable, scalable, and secure AI\-driven applications.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data validation, API testing, integration testing, and complex enterprise environments is highly desirable.

description:

Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Description:**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Instructional Designer \& Digital Learning Manager to join our team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical maritime engineering, safety compliance, and cutting\-edge digital education. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying highly interactive, high\-retention digital learning modules. Your content will train both shore\-based corporate teams and seafarers deployed globally on our vessels.
   

  

 The ideal candidate understands how adult brains learn and can translate dense technical manuals or safety management systems (SMS) into modern, engaging digital formats optimized for low\-bandwidth and offline environments.
   

  

 We expect the person to be able to liaise with external vendors for quick content development and hence knowledge of industry practices is appreciated.
   

  

 The position is also expected to actively participate in upgrade of our existing Learning Management System and will be responsible for management of the same.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
* Content Design \& Development: Create interactive e\-learning modules, micro\-learning assets, video explainers, and simulation\-based courses using Articulate 360 (Storyline/Rise) and Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Technical Translation: Collaborate closely with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)—including Marine Superintendents, Chief Engineers, and Safety Managers—to convert complex maritime regulations (IMO, MARPOL), engineering blueprints, and operational workflows into clear training content.
* Low\-Bandwidth Optimization: Architect digital packages (SCORM) specifically designed and compressed for smooth deployment on onboard vessel networks and mobile devices with limited internet connectivity.
* Multimedia Production: Script, film, record, and edit high\-quality instructional videos, animations (using Vyond or After Effects), graphic assets, and audio narration.
* Assessment \& Evaluation: Design rigorous, scenario\-based evaluations that measure practical decision\-making and compliance competency, bridging digital learning with onboard physical drills.
* LMS Maintenance: Package and publish courses according to e\-learning standards, ensuring seamless tracking, scoring, and data synchronization with our centralized Crewing and HR systems.


**Requirements:**
* Experience: 3\+ years of experience in instructional design and digital content creation. Experience within maritime, logistics, heavy engineering, aviation, oil \& gas, or defense sectors is highly preferred.
* Instructional Design Mastery: Strong foundation in adult learning theories (ADDIE, SAM, Gagne’s Nine Events) with a proven ability to architect micro\-learning frameworks.
* Authoring Tools: Expert\-level proficiency in Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise) or Adobe Captivate.
* Multimedia Skills: Hands\-on experience with Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator) and animation software like Vyond.
* Deep understanding of LMS platforms and features
* Technical \& Spatial Literacy: Ability to read technical documentation, process flowcharts, and spatial layouts to build accurate procedural training.
* Project Management: Excellent consultative soft skills to interview busy SMEs, handle stakeholder feedback loops, and manage multiple course development timelines simultaneously.


**Additional Desired Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Corporate Training, or a related field.
* Familiarity with maritime safety frameworks (SMS) and seafaring competence standards.
* Experience implementing AI\-assisted tools for rapid storyboarding, voiceovers, or asset generation.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

* Strong understanding of Scrum, Agile, and Lean principles.

* Experience working with cross‑functional engineering teams (Dev, QA, Architecture).

* Use Agile metrics (predictability, carryover, cycle time, throughput) to to identify trends and drive team improvement.
* Coach the team on Agile principles, accountability, and effective performance of their roles.


****Process Improvement****
* Drive continuous improvement in project management processes and delivery methodologies


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of overall experience in software development or technology delivery environments, including experience managing technical projects end\-to\-end.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Project Manager, Scrum Master, or Agile delivery leader for cross\-functional software or technology teams.
* Demonstrated experience leading project planning and delivery — scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and stakeholder reporting — alongside facilitating the full set of Scrum ceremonies and applying Agile principles in real\-world delivery environments.
* Strong track record identifying and driving resolution of impediments, delivery risks, dependencies, and cross\-team escalations.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery metrics (velocity, burndown, cycle time) and traditional project metrics (schedule, budget, milestones), and how to apply both to improve predictability and delivery outcomes.
* Experience leveraging AI tools for project tracking, status reporting, or risk surfacing, with an interest in driving continued adoption of AI\-driven PM practices.
* Proficiency with Jira or comparable Agile/project work\-management tools.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, communication, and conflict\-resolution skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both technical and business stakeholders and present to leadership.
* Experience in distributed or global delivery environments, with flexibility to overlap with U.S. client hours as required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, PMI\-ACP, or comparable Agile certification.
* Experience with enterprise clients in a consulting environment.
* Exposure to AI, Generative AI, data, cloud, or other emerging\-technology delivery environments.
* Experience in automotive, manufacturing, or related industries.

 A successful project manager with scrum master skills creates an environment in which:
   

  

* Projects deliver on scope, schedule, and budget, with risks and dependencies caught early
* Sprints run predictably — stable velocity, few blockers, high\-value ceremonies
* Status reporting to leadership is fast, clear, and AI\-assisted
* Engineering, product, and business teams stay aligned with minimal miscommunication or rework
* Impediments and escalations get resolved quickly
* AI tools are actively used to reduce manual PM overhead
* Delivery processes keep improving sprint over sprint
* Distributed team members stay fully integrated across time zones


 Ultimately, this role’s impact is visible in the team's ability to anticipate and resolve delivery challenges, make better decisions, and consistently deliver valuable outcomes.
